chunks.text: TUMBLE DRYER GUIDE How to Use the Dryer Only dry laundry that was washed in water. Never dry anything with petrol, solvents, cooking oil, wax or stain remover on it: wash it in hot water with detergent first. Fire risk. Never dry rubber, latex, foam rubber, shower caps or bathing caps. Take lighters and matches out of pockets.

Never use the dryer without the door filter, or with a damaged filter. The door, the back and the laundry get very hot. Keep children and pets away. Check only laundry is in the drum before you close the door. Do not stop the dryer before the end: the last part cools the laundry down. If you must stop it, take everything out quickly and spread it out to cool.

1 Check the care labels. Do not dry items marked "Do not tumble dry", leather, waxed or coated clothes, sequins, or clothes with large wooden, plastic, metal or rusting parts. 2 Sort laundry by type and thickness. Close zips and buttons, tie strings, turn pockets inside out. Put very delicate items in a laundry bag. 1 Plug in the dryer and press On/Off (1).

2 Pull the left side of the door to open it. Check the drum is empty, then put the laundry in. 3 Only dry laundry spun in the washer (800 rpm or faster). Shake out sheets and towels. Do not overfill: see the maximum load for each programme below. 1 Turn the knob (2) to a programme. The knob does not turn by itself during the programme.

2 Cotton, up to 8 kg: "cotton storage" (dry to put away), "standard" (dry), "iron" (slightly damp). For towels, sheets and thick cotton. 3 Mixed cotton and synthetics, up to 3.5 kg: "mix storage" (dry) or "mix iron" (delicate synthetics, ready to iron). Shirts, up to 2 kg: fewer creases.

4 Bedding, up to 5 kg. Down wear (down jackets, pillows, duvets), up to 1.5 kg. Dry large items alone. 5 Sports (sportswear, breathable fabrics) 3 kg. Baby 4 kg. Wool (softens wool and silk) 2 kg. Sensitive (very delicate synthetics, may stay slightly damp) 1 kg. Air refresh (no heat) 2 kg.

6 Time 30, 60 or 90 minutes, up to 4 kg: for items still a little damp, or for just a few small items, because the dryer may not sense when a tiny load is dry. Options (choose before you press Start) 1 Extra dry (4) dries more. Gentlecare (5) uses a lower heat for delicates.

2 Start delay (7): press it to choose when the dryer starts, from 30 minutes up to 24 hours. Then press Start/Pause (3). To cancel, hold Start delay for 3 seconds. From the manufacturer's manual, page 37.

3 Anti crease (10): press it to choose 1, 2 or 3 hours. The drum keeps turning after the end until you open the door. Use it if you cannot take the laundry out straight away. From the manufacturer's manual, page 38. 4 Dim lights show the options you can choose. If a button flashes and beeps, that option does not work with this programme. Options are not kept for the next load.

1 Press Start/Pause (3). Its light is steady while the dryer runs. The time left can change during the programme: this is normal. 2 To pause, press Start/Pause. Opening the door also pauses the dryer. Close the door and press Start/Pause to carry on.

3 To add laundry, open the door, press Start/Pause, add the items, close the door and press Start/Pause. Careful: the door and laundry are hot. 4 To change the programme, press On/Off twice (off, then on), choose again and press Start/Pause. 5 To cancel, hold Start/Pause for 3 seconds. The dryer cools down first.

6 If the water tank fills up, the dryer pauses and the tank light (9) comes on. Empty the tank and press Start/Pause. 1 "End" shows on the display. Open the door and take the laundry out straight away so it does not crease. 2 Clean the door filter, close the door and press On/Off (1). Empty the water tank and unplug the dryer (see the Dryer Care guide).

3 If you do nothing for 5 minutes, the display switches off to save power and Start/Pause flashes. Press On/Off, turn the knob or open the door to wake it. 1 Hold Extra dry (4) and Start delay (7) together for 3 seconds. The lock light (6) comes on and the settings cannot be changed. Do the same to unlock. The lock stays on after you switch off. Tips to save time and power

1 Dry full loads, spin laundry well and clean the filter every time: drying is faster and uses less power. 2 Do not over-dry: it can shrink clothes and makes ironing harder. Fabric softener in the washer is not needed. STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT You smell burning or see smoke, or the power cord is damaged.

It still does not heat after you clean the filter, or an error code comes back. The dryer needs to be moved, or the room could get below freezing. If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management.
Based on the manufacturer's manual for Gorenje Model DE8B. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

TUMBLE DRYER GUIDE Dryer Care Switch off and unplug the dryer before cleaning. Never use the dryer without the door filter or the condenser unit, or if either one is damaged. Fire risk. Never put chemicals or fragrances in the water tank. The water is not safe to drink.

Do not clean the dryer with a jet of water or with solvents. Children must not clean the dryer without an adult. 1 Door filter (1), condenser unit behind the covers at the bottom (2), water tank at the top left (3). After every load: clean the door filter 1 Open the door and lift the filter cover. Gently scrape the fluff off the filter with your hand or a cloth.

2 If needed, also wipe the filter housing and the door seal. Close the filter cover. Mind your fingers. The clean-filter light (8) reminds you to do this. After every load: empty the water tank 1 Pull the tank out with both hands. Turn it upside down over a sink. Pull out the spout to pour more easily. Careful: the water may be hot.

2 Push the tank back in all the way. If the tank is full, the dryer pauses and the tank light (9) comes on. 3 If property management has connected the dryer hose to a drain, you do not need to empty the tank. Ask if you are not sure. Regularly: clean the condenser unit

1 Do this whenever drying starts to take longer. The manual gives no set interval. Unplug the dryer and put a cloth on the floor: some water will spill. 2 Open the outer cover. Turn the two levers on the inside cover up and take the inside cover off. Turn the condenser lever up and pull the unit out by its handle.

3 Rinse the unit on both sides under running water and let it drain well. Do not poke between the ribs and do not put it in a dishwasher. 4 Wipe the space behind it, right to the back, and the seals with a soft damp cloth. 5 Slide the unit back in, turn its lever down, refit the inside cover and close the outer cover. Outside and around the dryer

1 Unplug the dryer. Wipe the outside with a soft damp cloth, then dry it. No solvents or harsh cleaners. Never spray it with water. 2 Keep the air vent at the front and the vents at the back clear. Do not push the dryer against the wall or furniture. 3 Keep fluff, dust and dirt from building up around the dryer. Let fresh air into the room while drying.

STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT You smell burning or see smoke, or the power cord is damaged. It still does not heat after you clean the filter, or an error code comes back. The door filter or the condenser unit is damaged or missing. Water leaks from the dryer or from its drain hose. The dryer needs to be moved, or the room could freeze: water left inside can damage it.

The inside needs its periodic clean by a service technician. If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management. Based on the manufacturer's manual for Gorenje Model DE8B. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

TUMBLE DRYER GUIDE Dryer Troubleshooting Never dry anything with petrol, solvents or cooking oil on it, or anything made of rubber or foam rubber. Fire risk. Do not open the dryer or try to repair it. Unplug it before you check anything. A code or light on the display 1 Tank light (9) or "Full": the water tank is full. Empty it and press Start/Pause (3).
2 PF: the power went off. Press Start/Pause (3) to carry on. This also restarts a start delay countdown. 3 E4: the dryer overheated. Clean the door filter, let the dryer cool down, then try again.

4 E0, E1, E2, E3, E6, E7 or E8: switch off, wait at least 1 minute, switch on and start again. If the code comes back, write it down, switch off, unplug the dryer and contact property management. 1 Check the plug is pushed in and On/Off (1) is pressed. If nothing lights up, check whether a breaker or fuse has tripped. 2 Close the door firmly, then press Start/Pause (3).

3 If the tank light (9) is on, empty the water tank, then press Start/Pause (3). 4 If a start delay is set, the dryer is waiting. Hold Start delay (7) for 3 seconds to cancel it. 5 If the buttons do nothing and the lock light (6) is on, hold Extra dry (4) and Start delay (7) for 3 seconds.

6 If the display is dark and Start/Pause flashes, the dryer went to sleep after 5 minutes. Press On/Off or turn the knob. 7 If a button flashes and beeps, that option does not work with the programme you chose. Laundry is not dry, or it takes too long 1 Clean the door filter. If that does not help, clean the condenser unit (see Dryer Care).

2 Only dry laundry that was spun in the washer. Do not overfill, and do not dry too little: for a few small items use the Time programme. 3 Sort laundry by type and thickness and choose the right programme. Use Extra dry, or run Time for another 30 to 60 minutes. 4 Let fresh air into the room: open a door or window. A very cold, very hot or small room makes drying slower.

5 Bedding rolls into a ball: close buttons and zips, use the Bedding programme, then loosen it and run Time. 1 It stops heating during a programme: the filter is probably blocked. Clean it, let the dryer cool down and try again. 2 The door opens during drying: there is too much laundry. Take some out.

3 Laundry is very creased: take it out as soon as it ends, do not overfill, or use Anti crease. 4 If your dryer has a drum light and it does not come on when you open the door, unplug the dryer and contact property management. 1 A pumping or water sound: the pump is moving water into the tank. 2 Rumbling or rattling: buttons and zips hitting the drum.

3 A light knocking after the dryer has not been used for a long time. It goes away by itself. 4 The time left changes during the programme, and the knob does not turn by itself. 5 The back of the dryer, the door and the water in the tank get hot. 1 Write down any code. The model and serial number are on the plate inside the door opening. STOP AND CONTACT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

You smell burning or see smoke, or the power cord is damaged. It still does not heat after you clean the filter, or an error code comes back. The drum light does not work, or water leaks from the dryer. If you are unsure, or if the problem continues, stop using the appliance and contact property management.
Based on the manufacturer's manual for Gorenje Model DE8B. Pictures are taken from that manual or are photos of this appliance. Updated 20 October 2026.

50 867526 TROUBLESHOOTING TABLE Problem/error Cause What to do? The machine will not start. The main switch is not switched on. Check whether the main switch is on. There is no voltage in the power outlet. Check the fuse. Check if the power cord plug is correctly inserted into the power outlet.

There is voltage in the outlet, but the drum does not spin and the appliance does not work. Open the door. Check if the door is closed properly. The condensate tank is full. Empty the condensate tank (see chapter CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE/Emptying the condensate tank ). Perhaps the START DELAY function was set. Programme was not started in accordance with the instructions. To cancel the start delay, press the position (7) START DELAY and hold for 3 seconds. Re-read the instructions for use again.
The appliance stops heating completely during a programme. The net filter may be clogged.

As a result, the temperature in the dryer rises, which in turn causes overheating, and therefore heating is switched off. Clean the net filter (see chapter CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE/ Cleaning the net filter in the door ). Wait for the appliance to cool down, and try running it again. If the dryer still fails to start, call a service technician. A slight hitting noise appears. If the dryer is out of use for a long period of time, the support elements are under stress at the same point. The noise will subside without any intervention.

The door opens during drying. Excessive load on the door (too much laundry in the drum). Reduce the amount of laundry. Unevenly dried laundry. Laundry of varying types and thickness, or excessive amount of laundry. Make sure you have sorted the laundry by type and thickness, whether you have added a suitable amount of laundry to the drum, and whether you have selected a suitable programme (see PROGRAMME TABLE).
51 867526 Problem/error Cause What to do?

Laundry not dried or drying takes too long Filter is not cleaned. Clean the filter (see chapter CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE/ Cleaning the net filter in the door ). Dryer is placed in a closed room; room that is too cold; or room that is too small and the air overheats as a result. Make sure there is adequate supply of fresh air to the dryer; for example, open the door and/or window. Check if the temperature in the room where the dryer is installed is too high or too low. Laundry was not sufficiently wrung or spun. If the laundry is still wet after the drying cycle, repeat the drying and select an appropriate drying programme (after cleaning the filter). Amount of laundry dried in the appliance is too large or insufficient. Use a suitable programme or extra functions. Laundry (such as bedding) gets tangled into large balls. Close the buttons or zippers on the laundry before drying. Select a suitable programme (e.g. the Bedding program). After the drying process, loosen the laundry and select an additional drying programme (e.g. Time (Timed drying program)).

Drum lighting error There is no lighting when the dryer door is opened. Disconnect the dryer from the power mains and call an authorized service unit. Errors indicated on the display unit may include the following: Problem/error Indication on the display unit and description of error What to do? E0 Control unit failure Call service centre. E1 Temperature sensor failure Call service centre. E2 Communication error Call service centre. E3
Pump error Call service centre.

52 867526 Problem/error Indication on the display unit and description of error What to do? E4 System overheating Clean the filter. See chapter CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE/Cleaning the net filter in the door or call a service technician. E6, E7, E8 Control unit failure Disconnect the tumble dryer from the power supply. Call service centre. Warnings indicated on the display unit may include the following: Warning

Indication on the display unit and description of warning What to do? Condensate tank warning Empty the condensate tank before resuming the programme (see chapter CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE/ Emptying the condensate tank ). PF Power supply failure warning Drying interrupted due to power supply failure.
Press the (3) START/PAUSE button to restart or resume the drying programme. Write down the error code (e.g. E0, E1), switch off the dryer, and call the nearest authorized service (call centre).

Sounds In the initial drying stage, the heat pump causes noise; this, however, does not affect the tumble dryer operation. Pumping or liquid flowing sound: the pump is pumping the condensate into the condensate tank. Rumbling or rattling noise: during drying when the laundry also includes hard parts (such as buttons, zippers etc.)
